requirements.requirement: The assembled review prototype shall be 315 mm long with a 27 mm nominal grip and a 190 mm exposed nonconductive spine.
requirements.acceptance: Overall length 315 +/- 2 mm; grip OD 27 +/- 0.2 mm; exposed spine 190 +/- 1 mm.
requirements.verification: drawing inspection plus physical first-article measurement

requirements.requirement: Commands shall be enabled only while the recessed press-to-arm control is continuously held.
requirements.acceptance: Release requests local disarm and receiver safe state within 100 ms target; measured worst case shall be recorded before use.
requirements.verification: hardware-in-loop timing test over normal, reset and packet-loss cases

requirements.requirement: Boot, reset, brownout, watchdog expiry and radio-link loss shall force every receiver output inactive.
requirements.acceptance: No output pulse on boot/reset; link-loss safe state within 250 ms target; recovery requires a fresh armed session.

requirements.requirement: The six-axis IMU shall classify calibrated short-window relative orientation and motion gestures; it shall not claim absolute position or an exact free-space 3D path.
requirements.acceptance: Per-class confusion matrix, rejection threshold and false-activation rate are recorded on representative users; low-confidence windows cause no action.
requirements.verification: labelled gesture dataset and supervised usability test

requirements.requirement: The BLE link shall use LE Secure Connections with physical pairing authorization and unique device credentials; commands shall also carry authenticated encryption, direction/session binding and a monotonic anti-replay sequence.
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate, stale, cross-device, unauthenticated and nonce-reuse test vectors are rejected without output activation.
requirements.verification: protocol unit tests, packet capture and negative security tests

requirements.requirement: The wand shall use one protected 1S LiPo cell with NTC supervision, a 5 V USB-C sink-only charge input and a regulated logic rail.
requirements.acceptance: Cell protection is present in the selected ordered part or an external protector; charge/current/temperature limits match the cell; no USB source role is exposed.
requirements.verification: ordered-part review, bench charge/thermal test and USB-C sink compliance check

requirements.requirement: The NINA-B302 antenna end shall face a nonconductive enclosure region and obey the current u-blox host-ground, metal, battery and enclosure restrictions.
requirements.acceptance: Layout keepout is checked against the controlled module integration manual and representative enclosure RF performance is measured.
requirements.verification: PCB/enclosure overlay review plus conducted or radiated RF comparison test

requirements.requirement: The receiver may expose only documented SELV interfaces: 3.3/5 V UART or PWM, an isolated open-collector interface, and a common-ground 5-12 V low-side MOSFET channel within declared ratings.
requirements.acceptance: Every connector pin, voltage domain, current limit, default state and external flyback requirement is labelled and tested.
requirements.verification: schematic/layout review, load test and connector fault injection

requirements.requirement: Mains loads shall be controlled only through a separately certified enclosed relay or contactor module using a receiver SELV control output.
requirements.acceptance: No mains conductor enters either AICAD PCB or enclosure; relay certification, ratings, creepage, wiring and installation remain external evidence.
requirements.verification: installation boundary review by a qualified electrical professional

requirements.requirement: Drone integration is limited to an autopilot-configured, non-flight-critical AUX or telemetry channel; the receiver shall not drive motors, ESC power stages, arming or primary flight controls.
requirements.acceptance: Autopilot configuration rejects the channel for arming/propulsion and fails safe on receiver loss; ground and restrained-prop tests precede any flight.
requirements.verification: qualified flight-system integrator review and staged ground test

requirements.requirement: Command feedback shall distinguish paired, armed, accepted, rejected and fault states without relying on motion alone.
requirements.acceptance: Haptic/indicator patterns are unambiguous in a blinded user test and fault feedback never activates an output.
requirements.verification: firmware state-machine test and supervised usability study

requirements.requirement: No drawing, model, schematic, PCB, firmware or BOM shall be marked factory/production released until its native-host, ordered-part, physical test and independent engineering gates close.
requirements.acceptance: All release locks remain false while any blocker is open; prototype quotation files are visibly marked review-only.
